notes.subject: עדים
notes.rationale: Hapax-olsem tok: 'ol de bilong meri' (menstrual soiling) o 'ol gavman' — planti tanim tok i usim 'ol nupela klos'; JPS 'polluted garment'.

notes.subject: צדקתינו
notes.rationale: צדקה i tanim 'tsedek' long hia, i no 'ol gutpela pasin' tasol — klostu 'stretpela pasin bilong yumi'.

notes.subject: כלנו…כל…כלנו
notes.rationale: Tok 'olgeta' i kamap tripela taim — olgeta man i no klia, olgeta i warapu; repitisen i no lus long tanim tok.

translation: Na yumi olgeta i kamap olsem man tambu, na olgeta tsedek bilong yumi olsem beged bilong ol de bilong meri; na yumi olgeta i warapu olsem lip, na ol biruarua bilong yumi, olsem win, ol i karim yumi i go.

tokens.gloss: ol i karim yumi i go
